decisions.reason: KiCad 9 library-variable compatibility affects project portability, not component availability, cost, or sourcing policy.
The source changes library-reference compatibility and does not alter BOM contents, part numbers, or assembly population requirements.
The source does not change JLCPCB ordering assistance, account setup, order configuration, or component-availability review.
The required Gerber, drill, pick-and-place, and BOM package remains unchanged; the source concerns portability of KiCad library references.
KiCad library-variable compatibility does not change the switched 5V rail's topology, GPIO control, voltage, or powered loads.
The source does not resolve or modify the standalone regulator capacity, activation condition, powered load, or source selection.
The shared term compatibility is incidental; KiCad path-variable compatibility does not affect sensor electrical logic levels or level-shifter policy.
The source does not change the ESP32 module, pin access, breakout arrangement, pitch, or platform-reuse requirement.
KiCad library references do not alter board orientation, enclosure adaptation, connector placement, or antenna keepout constraints.
The source does not alter the integrated board's sensor-module connector inventory, pinouts, or interface role.
The source does not change DCDC1 configuration, target rail voltage, diode-drop compensation, or regulation conditions.
The KiCad 9 reference-path decision does not change the future board variant's design, sensor integration, scope, or unresolved lifecycle.
